item.title: Hawas La Mer by Rasasi – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:

Type:

Overview

Fresh, juicy, and incredibly refreshing, Hawas La Mer by Rasasi is a fruity woody-aromatic fragrance that blends cooling mint, sparkling citrus, tart blackcurrant, green fig, and smooth amber woods.

It opens with peppermint, bergamot, and mandarin, creating an immediate rush of cool freshness balanced by bright, juicy citrus. The peppermint gives the opening an icy green character while the citrus keeps it vibrant and energetic.

As it develops, blackcurrant, jasmine, and carrot create a unique fruity-aromatic heart. Blackcurrant adds tart, juicy sweetness, jasmine provides a subtle floral smoothness, and carrot brings an earthy green nuance that gives the fragrance extra depth.

The dry-down combines fig, amber, and woody notes, creating a warmer, smoother finish while maintaining the fresh fruity character of the opening.

Inspired by Pacific Chill by Louis Vuitton, Hawas La Mer delivers that recognizable fresh minty-citrus and fruity-green style with a warm woody finish.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Peppermint, Bergamot, Mandarin
Middle: Blackcurrant, Jasmine, Carrot
Base: Fig, Amber, Woody Notes

Scent Profile

Hawas La Mer sits in the fruity / citrus / green / woody aromatic category.

Expect a fragrance that feels:

  • Fresh and cooling
  • Bright and citrusy
  • Juicy and fruity
  • Green and aromatic
  • Slightly earthy
  • Smooth and woody in the dry-down

Best For

Season: Spring, summer, and hot weather
Occasion: Everyday wear, vacations, beach days, daytime outings, casual dates
Style: Fresh, fruity, energetic, modern
Category: Fresh fruity summer signature scent

Try Before You Commit

Hawas La Mer begins with an icy burst of peppermint surrounded by bergamot and mandarin, creating a crisp and immediately refreshing first impression.

As it settles, blackcurrant adds juicy tartness while jasmine and carrot bring floral and green depth. Fig then becomes more noticeable alongside amber and woods, giving the dry-down a smoother and slightly warmer character without losing the freshness.
